english.title: Fly UK-registered helicopter under national operator's certificate over water without required apparatus
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a helicopter registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY HELICOPTER..), which carried out a Performance Class

(C)_[1]_
(D)_[2]_

operation, flying under and in accordance with the terms of a national air operator's certificate, and flew over water for the purpose of public transport for more than 15 minutes during a flight, namely **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT..), when not equipped with the required apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 130(1)(a) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location

when not equipped with the required apparatus
